description: Image-grounded claw-hammer strike smoke: SimToolReal RGB-D scene, VLM-marked start point and motion direction, public claw-hammer tool refs, whole-tool SE(3) fixed-goal rollout.

scene_initialization.start_pose_policy: runtime mesh-table-contact projection keeps the claw_hammer mesh on the tabletop with 3 mm clearance before the explicit grasp-lift stage.
scene_initialization.target_grounding_policy: The shared VLM scene-ref interface applies: natural task language and public top-down RGB-D evidence provide start_point on the visible nail top and scene.direction for the strike. Support-surface normals are projection/diagnostic evidence only.
scene_initialization.action_axis_policy: Lift uses the VLM-grounded scene.direction for this point-action task.
scene_initialization.endpoint_policy: Contact-only execution may reuse start_point as the executable end point while VLM scene.direction supplies the strike direction.

mainline_params.table_clearance_rule: all tool-part OBB corners must stay above the table plane

acceptance.success_policy: hammer_down_semantic_contact: a hammer down strike is successful when the VLM strike direction, diagnostic path gate, and rollout semantic contact/use-stage completion pass. Target displacement is diagnostic only because some targets are fixed.

tool_grounding_contract.notes: Evaluator-side audit labels only; not used for method selection, compiler constraints, or task success. Strike semantic/contact evidence is the required success metric for this smoke.

first_smoke: lifted refs record the VLM start point and scene.direction
constraint program uses public claw_hammer tool refs
fixed goals compile without hidden target geometry
rollout video and rollout_summary are written when rollout is enabled

contract_status.notes: Semantic contact/strike-direction success; target displacement is diagnostic.
